title: Linear steps
description: A simple sequence from a new request to completion.

flowchart.title: Prepare an order
flowchart.description: Follow each step from receiving the order to handing it to the carrier.

nodes.label: Order received
nodes.description: The customer completes checkout.
nodes.caption: New order

nodes.label: Pack the items
nodes.description: The fulfillment team checks and packs the ordered items.
nodes.caption: Ready for dispatch

nodes.label: Hand to the carrier
nodes.description: The carrier receives the parcel and its tracking information.

title: Decision branches
description: A decision with separate successful and unsuccessful outcomes.

flowchart.title: Check a payment
flowchart.description: Inspect the payment result before confirming the order.

nodes.label: Payment submitted
nodes.description: The payment provider returns a result.

nodes.label: Verify the result
nodes.description: Check the payment status and the expected amount.

nodes.label: Confirm the order
nodes.description: A verified payment allows fulfillment to continue.

nodes.label: Keep the order unpaid
nodes.description: Explain the payment failure to the customer.

title: Retry loop
description: A correction path returns to an earlier validation step.

flowchart.title: Review an application
flowchart.description: Request missing details and check the corrected application again.

nodes.label: Application submitted
nodes.description: The applicant sends the required information.

nodes.label: Review the details
nodes.description: The reviewer checks the application for completeness.
nodes.caption: Check required information

nodes.label: Request a correction
nodes.description: The applicant supplies the missing or corrected details.

nodes.label: Approve the application
nodes.description: The complete application is accepted.

title: Parallel paths
description: Several checks run alongside one another and join before completion.

flowchart.title: Prepare a shop launch
flowchart.description: Complete the catalog, payment and delivery checks before the final launch review.

nodes.label: Start the launch checks
nodes.description: The shop owner begins preparing the shop for its first customers.

nodes.label: Review the catalog
nodes.description: Check product details, prices and availability.
nodes.caption: Catalog team

nodes.label: Check payments
nodes.description: Confirm that the intended payment methods are ready.
nodes.caption: Finance team

nodes.label: Check delivery
nodes.description: Confirm the delivery areas, methods and rates.
nodes.caption: Operations team

nodes.label: Review all checks
nodes.description: The owner confirms that every required check is complete.

nodes.label: Open the shop
nodes.description: The shop is ready to receive customers.

title: Order workflow
description: A larger workflow combines parallel checks, a merge, a retry and separate final outcomes.

flowchart.title: From checkout to delivery
flowchart.description: Review payment, stock and address details, resolve problems, then prepare and track delivery. This diagram explains the workflow; it does not execute any operation.

nodes.label: Receive the order
nodes.description: The customer submits an order at checkout.
nodes.caption: Customer

nodes.label: Verify payment
nodes.description: Finance checks the provider result and the expected amount.
nodes.caption: Finance

nodes.label: Check stock
nodes.description: Fulfillment checks that the requested items are available.
nodes.caption: Fulfillment

nodes.label: Check the address
nodes.description: Operations checks that delivery is available for the supplied address.
nodes.caption: Operations

nodes.label: Review the order
nodes.description: Continue only after reviewing payment, stock and address checks.

nodes.label: Resolve missing details
nodes.description: Customer support requests corrected information, then sends the order back for review.

nodes.label: Pack the items
nodes.description: Fulfillment picks and packs the approved order.
nodes.caption: Fulfillment

nodes.label: Dispatch the parcel
nodes.description: The carrier receives the parcel and tracking information.
nodes.caption: Carrier

nodes.label: Check delivery
nodes.description: Use the carrier status to identify delivery or a delivery exception.

nodes.label: Delivery complete
nodes.description: The parcel reaches its destination.

nodes.label: Handle a delivery issue
nodes.description: Support investigates the carrier exception and agrees on the next action.

nodes.label: Cancel the order
nodes.description: An order that cannot proceed is cancelled through the normal order workflow.
